key: No active threads in these projects
zh: 这些项目中暂无进行中任务

key: Expo Simulators needs a paid Expo account. A session runs for up to 115 minutes and stops early when it is idle for the idle minutes, so idle minutes must be less than session minutes.
zh: Expo 模拟器需要付费的 Expo 账户。单次会话最长运行 115 分钟，若连续空闲达到设定的空闲分钟数则会提前结束，因此空闲分钟数必须小于会话分钟数。

key: Saving restarts this host and stops its running sessions.
zh: 保存将重启此主机并停止其正在运行的会话。
